items.label: Jabil Q4 FY2026 (09-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Regulated Industries detail (Steve Borges / CEO): the automo

set.signal: Regulated Industries detail (Steve Borges / CEO): the automotive portfolio's electrification and powertrain share was reduced from approximately 80% in fiscal 2023 to about 40% in fiscal 2026, with software-defined vehicle, compute and advanced driver assistance programs much of the balance; approximately 90% of fiscal 2026 automotive revenue came directly from OEMs. Defense and Aerospace is expected to be an important growth driver in fiscal 2027 as new programs move into production. In drug delivery Jabil expects to manufacture more than 700 million injectors and delivery pens in fiscal 2027; new auto-injector wins require expansion of the North Carolina site; the Croatia facility ramp continues in fiscal 2027 with full production in fiscal 2028. In Renewable and Energy Infrastructure, customer investment is broadening into energy storage, electrical infrastructure and thermal management; Jabil's focus areas include energy storage, grid power, HVAC and data center cooling and commercial power, and it is investing in targeted inorganic growth in power electronics and low-voltage switchgear.

items.reason: two wording drifts: source says SDV/compute/ADAS programs 'represent much of the balance' (not 'mostly'), and it is customer investment that is 'broadening into energy storage, electrical infrastructure, and thermal management' while data center cooling and commercial power are Jabil's stated focus areas
items.evidence: Software-defined vehicle, compute, and advanced driver assistance programs represent much of the balance. ... customer investment is broadening into energy storage, electrical infrastructure, and thermal management solutions.
